title: 2 Things You NEED to Do With ChatGPT Results ✍️
description:
Are the results from ChatGPT good to go? Maybe…but also maybe not. Before submitting AI-written material do an accuracy and a personalization pass. You want to carefully read the results and make sure the information is both factually correct and tonally personalized to your voice. #chatgpt #chatgpttips #jobsearch
